pixii-hand-cranked-dynamo.description: A dark workshop scene. A wooden frame holds two copper-wire coil spools at the top and a large dark horseshoe magnet in the middle. A metal shaft with a crank handle runs down the centre, and a weathered hand grips the crank on the right. Copper wires hang from the coils. A small electric spark glows at a copper commutator at the base. Jars, tools and metal scraps are scattered in the shadowy background, and the painting fills the whole image edge to edge.

siemens-self-excited-dynamo.description: An oil-style painting of a bearded man in a dark long coat, leaning over a workbench with both hands on an electric machine. The machine has a copper-wound drum, a visible spark at the contact point, and a belt-driven pulley. Behind him are coiled cables, a glowing lantern, gears and a window. The scene looks like a late-19th-century workshop. No text or signature is visible, and the painting runs edge to edge with no frame.

godalming-public-electricity-supply.description: A large wooden waterwheel turns on a mill race beside a dark brick mill, churning white water. Behind it, a dusk street of half-timbered and brick buildings with a church spire, lit by glowing lamp posts. Two figures in long dark coats and a shawl walk on the wet cobbles. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible text.

pearl-street-station-opens.description: Interior of a 19th-century industrial hall. A large vertical steam engine with a brass-banded cylinder and a big flywheel dominates the centre-right, with a second engine behind it and steam rising. In the foreground, workmen with shovels dig a trench in a cobbled street, and a fire glows in the hole. Through an arched brick doorway on the left, a dusk street shows gas lamps and men holding torches. No visible text, frame or border.

chicago-worlds-fair-ac-power.description: A night scene of a grand neoclassical building with several domes, outlined in warm glowing lights and lit by searchlight beams against a black sky. A dark water channel in the foreground holds small boats and a gondola, with golden reflections on the water. At the lower left and right, people in 19th-century dress (top hats, long gowns, parasols) stand on a quay. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible text, border or frame.

larderello-geothermal-plant.description: An oil-style night scene of a vintage steam-era machine on a wooden platform, with a tall pipe rising from a pump or engine with a flywheel, a valve on a side pipe, and white steam billowing around it. Four or five men in dark suits and fedora or bowler hats stand around, under a string of glowing incandescent bulbs, with torches at the edges and steam plumes rising from a dark hillside behind. There is no visible text, signature, frame or border, and the painting fills the image edge to edge. Nothing is gory or nude.

britain-national-grid-live.description: Several tall dark steel lattice pylons stride across rolling green fields under a stormy sky, with high-voltage cables sweeping diagonally across the frame. In the distance on the right, a power station with two tall chimneys emits dark smoke and white steam. The style is an oil-painting, with loose brushwork and warm sunset light breaking through the clouds. No people, text, border or frame are visible.

smith-putnam-wind-turbine.description: A tall steel lattice tower stands on a wooded hillside with autumn foliage in orange and brown. At its top is a large rotor with two long, glass-paneled blades that stretch out against a heavy, stormy sky. A small figure stands at the base beside a small hut and cables, with utility poles along the slope. The painting runs edge to edge with no visible text, frame or border.

the-geysers-geothermal-plant.description: A painted hillside of dark scrub and rock, with large white steam plumes rising from a wellhead and stack near the top. Insulated pipes run down the slope to a small metal-clad plant building with a cylindrical tank and machinery beside it. Moody oil-painting palette, no people, no visible text, and the painting fills the whole image.

northeast-blackout-1965.description: A painted night view over a river toward a dense Manhattan-like skyline of mostly dark towers under a bright full moon and clouds. A suspension bridge with a stream of car headlights runs diagonally through the foreground, with dark low buildings with a few lit windows at lower left. No text, frame or people; fills the canvas edge to edge.
